previous_statement: Upsilon-unit branch and assembly. By lem-routef-raw-factor-norms at n=1, for every X in B, ||v(X)||=||tilde-Delta(X)||>=(1-C_V*eta)||X||. Since v is bijective and b=C_V*eta<=1/4, u=v^(-1) satisfies ||u||<=1/(1-b). Formation gives tilde-Phi^2=tilde-Phi, A=Im(tilde-Phi), A with its inherited unit I, and u=v^(-1); hence I belongs to A=Im(tilde-Phi), idempotence gives tilde-Phi(I)=I, and def-routef-raw-factor-setting gives tilde-Upsilon(I)=u(tilde-Phi(I))=u(I). Thus tilde-Upsilon(I)-I_B=u(I-v(I_B)). The extended-isomorphism unit estimate gives ||I-v(I_B)||<=C_V*eta, so ||tilde-Upsilon(I)-I_B||<=C_V*eta/(1-b)<=3*C_V*eta<=C_T*eta (because b<=1/4 implies 1/(1-b)<=4/3<=3). Together with the Delta-unit estimate, taking the maximum proves max{||tilde-Delta(I)-I||,||tilde-Upsilon(I)-I||}<=C_T*eta on 0<=eta<=rho_unit=rho_T.
new_statement: Upsilon-unit branch. By lem-routef-raw-factor-norms at n=1, for every X in B, ||v(X)||=||tilde-Delta(X)||>=(1-C_V*eta)||X||. Since v is bijective and b:=C_V*eta<=1/4 (from eta<=rho_T<=1/[4*(1+C_V)]), u=v^(-1) satisfies ||u||<=1/(1-b). Lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation gives tilde-Phi^2=tilde-Phi, A=Im(tilde-Phi), A with its inherited unit I, and u=v^(-1); hence I belongs to A=Im(tilde-Phi), idempotence gives tilde-Phi(I)=I, and def-routef-raw-factor-setting gives tilde-Upsilon(I)=u(tilde-Phi(I))=u(I). Thus tilde-Upsilon(I)-I_B=u(I-v(I_B)). The unit clause of the delta-homomorphism contained in the registered definition def-extended-delta-inclusion, applied to the extended C_E*epsilon_AI(eta)-isomorphism v from formation, gives ||I-v(I_B)||<=C_E*epsilon_AI(eta)<=bar C_E*C_A*eta=C_V*eta. Consequently ||tilde-Upsilon(I)-I_B||<=C_V*eta/(1-b)<=3*C_V*eta<=C_T*eta, because b<=1/4 gives 1/(1-b)<=4/3<=3 and C_T=C_theta+3*C_V with C_theta>=0.
